entities.summary: Jennifer Elizabeth Brady is an American professional tennis player. She reached a career-high singles WTA ranking of world No. 13 in February 2021, and a career-high doubles ranking of No. 44 in August 2019. Brady has won one WTA Tour singles title and one doubles title, as well as four singles and five doubles titles on the ITF Women's Circuit. Her best performance at the majors was a runner-up finish at the 2021 Australian Open.
